overall: The AG found the committee violated the OML by failing to make open session minutes available within 10 days, but found no OML violation on non-minute records and only issued a reminder on complaint procedure.

allegations.summary: Requester alleged the committee withheld open session minutes requested in November 2014, which were not provided within the 10-day window.
allegations.key_passage: Its failure to do so violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Requester alleged the committee improperly withheld non-minute records (school physician, head injury and concussion policy records) and refused electronic posting.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not govern a public body's obligation to respond to public records requests.

allegations.summary: Committee responded to the three OML complaints only by email, without sending them to the AG or convening a meeting to review them.
allegations.key_passage: The Committee should have sent copies of the complaints, along with its response, to our office.

remedy: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and we caution that similar future violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
